# Puente

> Real-time voice translation on your phone. Offline. Free. Open source (AGPLv3).

Puente is a mobile app for live voice translation that runs entirely on-device after an initial model download. No accounts, no cloud processing of your audio. Built by Pablo Vallejo.

## Canonical URLs

- Spanish (default): https://puente.app/
- Catalan: https://puente.app/ca/
- English: https://puente.app/en/

## Key facts

- Product: Puente — offline, on-device voice translation for Android
- App code license: GNU AGPLv3 (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html)
- Website license: GNU AGPLv3 only, AGPL-3.0-only (https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html)
- AI models: separately licensed; the app's AGPLv3 license does not replace their licenses
- Privacy: audio is processed on the device; not sent to servers; not stored
- Speech recognition: Whisper and other downloadable models, selected according to language and device
- Translation: NLLB, SalamandraTA or MADLAD-400, depending on the selected model
- Status: source code available on GitHub; Google Play release coming soon
- Author: Pablo Vallejo

## Source code

- https://github.com/pablovallejodev/puente
- Website source: https://github.com/pablovallejodev/puente-web
